ceviri.20: What exactly can an AI chatbot added to a website do?
ceviri.21: It understands the visitor's question, finds the right answer in your site's content base, gives product and service information, and directs booking or contact requests. On questions outside its scope it passes the conversation automatically to the relevant team or to your WhatsApp line.
ceviri.22: Is the chatbot trained on our own content, or is a general AI answering?
ceviri.23: The chatbot uses a dedicated knowledge base built from your site's pages and your own documents. It doesn't chat about random subjects the way a general AI would; it bases its answers only on the content source you've defined.
ceviri.24: Does building your own website with ChatGPT replace a professional AI integration?
ceviri.25: No. ChatGPT is a general-purpose chat tool and isn't connected to your site's data, your brand voice or your business processes. In a professional integration the chatbot is embedded in your site, confined to your own content and connected to channels like WhatsApp; that's a different piece of engineering from dropping in an off-the-shelf chat window.
ceviri.26: What happens if the chatbot gives a wrong or misleading answer — who's in control?
ceviri.27: Because the chatbot only answers from the defined content base, the risk of error is limited; even so, every conversation is logged and reviewed regularly. When a problematic answer is found, the content base is updated and the boundaries are redefined. The final say is always yours.
ceviri.28: Can chatbot conversations be handed over to WhatsApp?
ceviri.29: Yes. Depending on what the visitor asks for, the chatbot can direct the conversation to your WhatsApp line, so a conversation that starts on the site continues with your team without a break and the enquiry isn't lost.
ceviri.30: Can AI integration be added to an existing site later?
ceviri.31: Yes — the chatbot can be added to an existing site as a separate widget; it doesn't require rebuilding the site's design or its foundation. The knowledge base is built from your existing pages and documents.

ceviri.65: How Does the Chatbot Learn? Your Own Knowledge Base
ceviri.66: The system we build isn't a general chat engine; it rests on a dedicated knowledge base made up of your site's pages, your service descriptions, your FAQs and the documents you share.
ceviri.67: When a question comes in, the chatbot searches that knowledge base first and keeps its answer confined to what it finds there. This approach cuts the risk of invented answers and stops it straying outside your brand voice. As your services change, the answers are refreshed by updating the knowledge base — the chatbot doesn't have to be rebuilt.
ceviri.69: Boundaries, Review and the Handover-to-Human Mechanism
ceviri.70: We set clear boundaries for the chatbot, defining which subjects it can answer on and which situations it must stay out of.
ceviri.71: In cases such as price negotiation, complaint handling or complex requests, the conversation is automatically directed to a member of staff or to your WhatsApp line. The full conversation history is logged, so it's visible which questions went unanswered and the knowledge base can be strengthened accordingly. Control always stays with you; the chatbot isn't an independent decision-maker but a layer working within a defined frame. Chat logs are personal data too;

ceviri.125: The Technical Setup: Widget, API and Data Sources
ceviri.126: The chatbot sits on your site as a small widget and talks to your knowledge base through an API in the background. The knowledge base is built from site pages, product and service catalogues, FAQs and the documents you share. A WhatsApp Business integration lets the conversation continue without changing channel.
ceviri.127: Brand Voice and Updating the Content
ceviri.128: The chatbot's tone is defined around your corporate voice; formal, friendly or technical. When a new service is added or a piece of information changes, the knowledge base is updated without rebuilding the chatbot, and the change shows in the answers straight away.
ceviri.130: The conversation logs show which questions come up most and which went unanswered. That data is used to widen the knowledge base regularly and to optimize the welcome messages and routing rules.

_kararlar.2 uydurmaz → doesn't invent answers: Türkçe 'bilmediği soruyu uydurmaz' sayfanın ana dürüstlük iddiası. İngilizcede 'hallucinate' teknik jargon; 'invent answers' hem doğru hem her okur için anlaşılır.
_kararlar.bilgi tabanı → knowledge base: Sektör terimi. 'içerik tabanı' da aynı şeyi anlatıyor; İngilizcede ikisi de 'knowledge base' / 'content base' olarak ayrıldı — 20/111'de 'content base', 65/66'da 'knowledge base', kaynak metindeki ayrımı koruyor.
_kararlar.62 DEVİR → HANDOVER: İnsana devir mekanizmasının rozeti. Site genelinde 'handover' kullanıldı (hakkımızda sayfasında 'Devir dosyası' → 'Handover pack').
_kararlar.72 KVKK aydınlatma yükümlülüğü: Kanun kısaltması korundu, 'duty to inform' ile açıklandı. /teklif/ sayfasındaki 'Aydınlatma metni' → 'Privacy notice' kararıyla tutarlı: orada belge adı, burada yükümlülük.
_kararlar.78 markaniz.com → yourbrand.com: Site geneli tek yer tutucu alan adı.
_kararlar.24-25/106 ChatGPT karşılaştırması: Ajansın kendi hizmetini ücretsiz bir araçla karşılaştırdığı dürüst bölüm; 'farklı bir mühendislik işidir' ifadesi 'a different piece of engineering' olarak korundu, yumuşatılmadı.
_kararlar.53 asistan eğitiliyor → assistant in tra: Animasyon etiketi; 'being trained' edilgen ve uzun, rozet kutusuna sığmaz.
